card.name: Maintenance and rapid-change dosing words
card.fires_on: The word "maintenance" in opioid reassessment text ("assess the maintenance of pain control") and in "maintenance dose". It also fires on a few other dosing-course words such as "rapid" before dosage reduction, "taken" before MAOIs, and "injections".

modes.label: Maintenance of pain control
modes.description: "maintenance" in the standard opioid sentence telling prescribers to reevaluate patients to assess maintenance of pain control.

modes.label: Maintenance dose
modes.description: "maintenance" directly before the word dose in recommended-dose wording.
modes.example: ine tablets. The recommended<< maintenance>> dose of lamotrigine tablets as

modes.label: Other dosing-change words
modes.description: Words describing a change or gap in treatment, such as "rapid" before dosage reduction or "taken" before MAOIs within a time window.
modes.example: abrupt discontinuation or<< rapid>> dosage reduction of diazepam rectal
